title: State Government Health Scheme (SGHS) – Uttarakhand Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Cashless government health scheme for eligible Uttarakhand state government employees, pensioners and specified family members.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on Uttarakhand government employment/pension status and the current SGHS beneficiary rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under State Government Health Scheme (SGHS) – Uttarakhand.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
